description: HITL flagging rules for MIUL designation validation

rules.detection: Check if designation matches known garbled patterns
rules.hitl_prompt: Designation appears garbled. Please verify from source drawing.

rules.description: Part number is actually a drawing note reference (e.g., '5.', '6.')
rules.hitl_prompt: This is a drawing note reference, not a part number. Typically a consumable (lubricant, sealant). Please specify the exact material from the drawing note.

rules.description: Part number has trailing note reference that should be stripped
rules.detection: PN ends with space + digit(s) + period

rules.hitl_prompt: Which Inconel alloy? Options: 625 (weld/corrosion), 718 (strength/springs), X-750 (springs/bolts), 600 (general purpose). Check source drawing.
Which nickel alloy? If safety wire (MS20995), it's Inconel X-750.

rules.description: A286 without CRES suffix or strength class
rules.hitl_prompt: A286 needs: CRES suffix confirmed, strength class (KSI) if fastener, and AMS spec number.
rules.notes: Almost always A286 CRES (UNS S66286). Std parts DB resolves most cases.

rules.hitl_prompt: MISC typically means assembly with multiple material types. Options: (1) Mark as 'VARIOUS', (2) Specify primary material, (3) Leave as MISC with note.

rules.detection: Designation is empty AND description does not contain 'ASSEMBLY' or 'SUB-ASSEMBLY'
rules.hitl_prompt: No material designation found. Check source drawing or specify material.

rules.description: Part has no description or nomenclature
rules.hitl_prompt: Part description is missing. Check source drawing.

rules.description: Assembly or sub-assembly with no material — expected behavior
rules.detection: Designation is empty AND description contains 'ASSEMBLY' or 'SUB-ASSEMBLY'
rules.notes: Assemblies don't carry material designation. Material is on child detail parts.
